name: option-list
title: Option List
description: Picker panel with option rows, search, checks, and footer actions. Rows compose List Item. Configure root width and panel match. Select composes this.

api.description: Open panel and option rows for pickers. Select composes this list for its menu. Row chrome is List Item: use that page for size, muted or accent variants, asChild hosts, and standalone rows outside a picker. Configure root width for the trigger shell; open-list width follows that mode unless OptionListContent overrides alignItemWithTrigger. Full keyboard support: arrow keys, Home and End, Enter, typeahead, and focus return to the trigger on close.

groups.title: OptionList
groups.description: Root selection, open state, and width.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: Single value or multiple values.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value in single mode.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial value in single mode.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when the single value changes.

props.name: values
props.description: Controlled values in multiple mode.

props.name: defaultValues
props.description: Uncontrolled initial values in multiple mode.

props.name: onValuesChange
props.description: Called when multiple values change.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Uncontrolled initial open state.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the panel opens or closes.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Close after choosing a row. Defaults to true in single mode, false in multiple.

props.name: width
props.description: Root width for triggers and always-visible panels (including chrome panel). hug sizes to content. fill stretches to the parent. Pass a CSS length such as 12rem for a fixed width. Select triggers inside follow the same width. Fill and fixed also default the open menu to match the trigger; hug defaults the menu to option content. Override with OptionListContent alignItemWithTrigger.

props.name: itemChrome
props.description: Default List Item chrome for every OptionListItem (padding, gap, type size/family/weight/color, radius, fills, and stroke). Per-item chrome props on OptionListItem win. See List Item for the full chrome contract.

props.name: submenuAnimated
props.description: Default motion for all nested OptionListSubmenu panels. true plays open/close animations; false makes nested menus appear and disappear instantly. Overridden by OptionListSubmenu or OptionListSubContent animated.

props.name: submenuOpenDuration
props.description: Default open animation duration in milliseconds for nested submenus. Ignored when submenuAnimated is false. Overridden by OptionListSubmenu or OptionListSubContent openDuration.

props.name: submenuCloseDuration
props.description: Default close animation duration in milliseconds for nested submenus. Ignored when submenuAnimated is false. Overridden by OptionListSubmenu or OptionListSubContent closeDuration.

groups.title: OptionListTrigger
groups.description: Opens and closes the option list. Use render to compose onto Badge or another host.

props.name: render
props.description: Host element to clone trigger behavior onto (for example Badge). Owns click, keyboard, and anchor ref.

props.name: children
props.description: Trigger content (label, chevron, etc.).

props.name: className
props.description: Additional styles.

props.name: …button attributes
props.description: Native button props when not using render.

groups.title: OptionListContent
groups.description: Portaled or inline panel with optional header, search, scroll, footer, and dismissOnScroll.

props.name: align
props.description: Horizontal anchor relative to the trigger. auto picks the best fit.

props.name: alignItemWithTrigger
props.description: Configure open-list width. true matches the trigger. false hugs the longest option (floored at --df-menu-min-width). Omit to follow the root width prop: hug defaults to false; fill and fixed default to true.

props.name: side
props.description: Preferred placement side. Flips when there is not enough space.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Gap between trigger and panel.

props.name: alignOffset
props.description: Shift along the alignment axis.

props.name: portal
props.description: Render in a portal. Set false for inline previews.

props.name: chrome
props.description: menu keeps popover fill, shadow, and radius. plain drops those so the list can sit inside a host surface. panel is a bordered card for always-visible lists.

props.name: background
props.description: Surface fill for any chrome mode. Sets --df-option-list-surface-bg. Prefer a token such as var(--card) or var(--popover).

props.name: foreground
props.description: Surface text color for any chrome mode. Sets --df-option-list-surface-fg. Header label inherits this color.

props.name: borderColor
props.description: Outer surface stroke only. Sets --df-option-list-surface-border-color. Does not change header, search, or footer rules; use dividerColor for those.

props.name: borderWidth
props.description: Outer surface stroke width. Sets --df-option-list-surface-border-width. Prefer var(--border-width-hairline).

props.name: borderStyle
props.description: Outer surface stroke style. Sets --df-option-list-surface-border-style. Default solid.

props.name: dividerColor
props.description: Hairline rules on header, search, and footer. Sets --df-option-list-divider-color. Defaults to var(--border).

props.name: radius
props.description: Surface corner radius for any chrome mode. Sets --df-option-list-surface-radius. Prefer a radius token such as var(--radius-xl).

props.name: dismissOnScroll
props.description: Close when the page scrolls. Scrolling inside the list stays open. Set false to keep the panel following the trigger (it can cover sticky chrome).

props.name: header
props.description: Panel header above the options. Prefer OptionListHeader for a label, description, and edge-to-edge bottom rule. Stacks the panel like search and footer.

props.name: search
props.description: Show a search field above the options.

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.description: Placeholder for the search field.

props.name: searchBackground
props.description: Search field fill. Prefer tokens such as var(--muted). Forwards to SearchInput background. Named separately because background themes the panel surface.

props.name: searchValue
props.description: Controlled search query.

props.name: defaultSearchValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial search query.

props.name: onSearchChange
props.description: Called when the search query changes.

props.name: scrollable
props.description: Wrap options in the kit ScrollArea (custom scrollbar). Defaults on for plain panels and off when the panel contains a submenu; pass explicitly to override.

props.name: scrollMaxHeight
props.description: Max height of the scrollable body before it scrolls (stacked panels default to var(--df-menu-stacked-max-height)). When the panel opens, the selected option scrolls into the list scrollport while list order stays the same.

props.name: scrollThumbGap
props.description: Space on each side of the scrollbar thumb, in pixels. Defaults to one spacing unit via --df-option-list-scroll-thumb-gap.

props.name: footer
props.description: Footer actions under the options (for example Reset).

props.name: className
props.description: Panel surface styles.

groups.title: OptionListItem
groups.description: Selectable List Item with value, search filter, and submenu trigger behavior. Forwards List Item presentation props (size, variant, leading, trailing, layout, and full chrome: padding, type, fills, stroke, radius). Selection, highlight, and open state stay owned by Option List. Nested submenu triggers pass the chevron through trailing; List Item renders it. Inside OptionListSubmenu (trigger zone) the row opens the submenu on hover instead of selecting. For standalone rows and asChild links, see List Item.

props.name: value
props.description: Option value stored in selection state.

props.name: size
props.description: List Item density. Forwarded to List Item. Use sm for compact nested submenu rows.

props.name: variant
props.description: List Item fill recipe. Forwarded to List Item. accent is the picker default; muted is for quiet nav-style rows.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Not selectable row.

props.name: leading
props.description: Leading slot before the label. Works with inline, stacked, and columns layouts. On stacked rows, the icon aligns to the title line. On columns rows, leading hugs text content. Custom nodes are content: set aria-hidden on decorative icons. Pass an icon or other node; use "checkbox" for multi-select, "check" for a leading selected mark, or false to omit.

props.name: secondary
props.description: Supporting copy beside or under the label.

props.name: layout
props.description: inline places secondary beside the label; stacked places it underneath; columns is leading, main, and trailing text with the main label horizontally centered in the row and height from content. With leading on stacked rows, the icon aligns to the title line. Select mirrors stacked layout in the trigger value.

props.name: trailing
props.description: End of row slot: badge counter, nested menu chevron, measure text, or both. When set, the selected check is hidden unless indicator is forced on. Submenu triggers pass the chevron here; List Item renders the trailing slot.

props.name: indicator
props.description: Selected check in single mode. Defaults off when leading is checkbox or trailing is set; otherwise on.

props.name: children
props.description: Primary label text for the row.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional row styles.

props.name: style
props.description: Host style. Merged after List Item chrome CSS variables.

props.name: padding / paddingX / paddingY / sides
props.description: List Item chrome padding props. Forwarded to List Item. See List Item for the full cascade and --df-list-item-padding-* tokens.

props.name: gap / fontSize / fontFamily / fontWeight / radius
props.description: List Item chrome spacing, type (size, family, weight), and radius. Forwarded to List Item.

props.name: background / foreground / hoverBackground / hoverForeground
props.description: List Item chrome resting and hover fills and label colors. Forwarded to List Item. Root OptionList or Select itemChrome supplies defaults; these props win per row.

props.name: selectedBackground / selectedForeground / selectedHoverBackground / activeBackground
props.description: List Item chrome selected and pressed fills. Forwarded to List Item. See List Item for --df-list-item-* tokens.

props.name: borderWidth / borderColor / borderStyle
props.description: List Item chrome stroke. Forwarded to List Item. Prefer var(--border-width-hairline) and var(--border). Default width is 0.

props.name: …host attributes
props.description: Native host element props on the List Item row. Use the highlighted data attribute for hover or open parent rows in nested menus. Ref is composed with the Option List submenu trigger ref.

groups.title: OptionListSubmenu
groups.description: Hover open nested branch. Wrap a trigger OptionListItem and an OptionListSubContent. The trigger is a normal OptionListItem, so List Item size, variant, trailing chevron, and chrome props apply. Nest again inside the content for deeper levels. Motion defaults inherit from OptionList and can be overridden here.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled submenu open state.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Uncontrolled initial open state (useful for docs previews).

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the submenu opens or closes.

props.name: animated
props.description: true plays fade/slide open and close for this branch. false opens and closes instantly with no motion. Prefer OptionList submenuAnimated=false to turn off motion for every nested level at once.

props.name: openDuration
props.description: Open animation duration in milliseconds for this branch. Only applies when animated is true.

props.name: closeDuration
props.description: Close animation duration in milliseconds for this branch. Only applies when animated is true. Keep this shorter than openDuration for a snappy dismiss.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: Milliseconds to wait after the pointer leaves the branch before starting close. Gives time to move into the child panel. Exit animation (if animated) starts after this delay.

props.name: children
props.description: Trigger OptionListItem plus OptionListSubContent (and nested submenus).

groups.title: OptionListSubContent
groups.description: Child panel for a submenu. Opens on hover of the parent row; nest further OptionListSubmenu trees inside. Placement and motion can be set per panel.

props.name: side
props.description: Preferred placement relative to the parent row. Flips when there is not enough space.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Gap between the parent row and the child panel.

props.name: align
props.description: Alignment along the parent row.

props.name: alignOffset
props.description: Shift along the alignment axis.

props.name: portal
props.description: Render in a portal. Set false for inline nested previews in docs.

props.name: animated
props.description: Per panel motion override. false makes this panel appear and disappear instantly even if parent submenus are animated.

props.name: openDuration
props.description: Per panel open duration in milliseconds. Ignored when animated is false.

props.name: closeDuration
props.description: Per panel close duration in milliseconds. Ignored when animated is false.

props.name: className
props.description: Panel surface styles.

props.name: children
props.description: Option rows and nested OptionListSubmenu branches.

groups.title: OptionListSearch
groups.description: Search field used when content search is composed manually.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Empty-state hint.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled query.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial query.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when the query changes.

props.name: size
props.description: SearchInput size.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Show clear control when filled.

props.name: background
props.description: Search field fill. Prefer tokens such as var(--muted). Same contract as SearchInput background.

groups.title: OptionListBody
groups.description: Scrollable or static body wrapping option rows.

props.name: scrollable
props.description: Wrap children in ScrollArea.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Height constraint when scrollable.

props.name: scrollThumbGap
props.description: Space on each side of the scrollbar thumb, in pixels.

props.name: children
props.description: Option rows.

groups.title: OptionListHeader
groups.description: Panel title block with an edge-to-edge bottom rule. Distinct from OptionListLabel, which is an in-list group heading.

props.name: label
props.description: Primary panel title (uppercase label style). When set, OptionListContent names the listbox with aria-labelledby.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting copy under the label.

props.name: children
props.description: Optional content below the description.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional styles.

props.name: children
props.description: Footer actions (for example Reset / Select all).

props.name: className
props.description: Additional styles.

props.name: OptionListGroup
props.description: Groups related items.

props.name: OptionListLabel
props.description: Group heading inside the panel. Renders ListItemLabel with variant menu. See List Item for nav-style section titles.

props.name: OptionListSeparator
props.description: Horizontal rule between in-list sections. inset false (default) spans the full content width. inset true follows panel content padding via --df-option-list-separator-inset. For a panel header rule that touches both edges, use OptionListHeader.

props.name: OptionListSeparator.inset
props.description: When true, inset the rule to match group padding plus default row horizontal padding. Override distance with --df-option-list-separator-inset.

props.name: OptionListScrollUpButton / ScrollDownButton
props.description: Optional scroll affordances for long lists.

props.name: useOptionListContext
props.description: Read open state, selection, labels, and search from parts.

props.name: Hug content
props.description: Default root width. Trigger and inline panel (including chrome panel) size to content.

props.name: Fill parent
props.description: Stretch the root, trigger, and inline panel to the full width of the parent.

props.name: Fixed width
props.description: Pass a CSS length on OptionList such as 12rem or 200px. Sets --df-option-list-width on the root.

props.name: Hug menu content
props.description: Open menu width follows option content. Default when root width is hug, or pass false to override fill and fixed.

props.name: Match trigger width
props.description: Lock open menu width to the trigger. Default when root width is fill or fixed.

props.name: Inline previews
props.description: Render the panel in place for docs and nested layouts.

props.name: Card panel
props.description: Bordered card surface for always-visible lists. Pair with OptionListHeader for a label, description, and edge-to-edge rule. Size with OptionList width (hug, fill, or a CSS length). Theme the surface with background, foreground, borderColor, borderWidth, borderStyle, and radius.

props.name: Trailing badge counter
props.description: Number badge at the end of the row. Right padding matches checkbox rows; selected check stays hidden.

props.name: Nested submenu row
props.description: Hover the parent row to open the child panel on the right. Nest Submenu trees for three or more levels. Use trailing for badge + ChevronRight. Control motion with submenuAnimated / animated (boolean) and submenuOpenDuration / submenuCloseDuration or openDuration / closeDuration (ms).

props.name: Instant nested menus
props.description: Disable open/close animation for every nested level from OptionList. Equivalent per branch: OptionListSubmenu animated={false}.

props.name: Custom nested speed
props.description: Set open and close durations in milliseconds on OptionList (defaults 180 / 90). Override on a single Submenu or SubContent when one branch should feel different.

props.name: Item spacing
props.description: Rows use kit gap and hover/selected/disabled states via data attributes.

props.name: List Item props
props.description: OptionListItem and submenu trigger rows render List Item. size, variant, slots, and chrome props forward through. Open and selected appearance are controlled by Option List. Open the List Item page for the full contract and standalone use.

groups.title: Keyboard & accessibility
groups.description: Applies to portaled panels. Inline panels (portal={false}) keep the page focus flow unchanged.

props.name: Open & focus
props.description: Opening moves focus into the panel, or the search field when one is present. Closing by keyboard or selection returns focus to the trigger.

props.name: Arrow keys
props.description: Move the active option with wrap around the ends. Home and End jump to the first and last option.

props.name: Select
props.description: Enter selects the active option. Space selects when focus is on the panel; inside the search field Space types a space.

props.name: Typeahead
props.description: Jump to the first option that starts with the typed query, then to any option that contains it. The buffer clears after a short pause. Disabled while a search field is present.

props.name: Submenus
props.description: Opens the submenu when the active row is a submenu trigger.

props.name: ARIA
props.description: The panel is a listbox with aria-activedescendant on the active option. When OptionListHeader has a label, the listbox uses aria-labelledby. The trigger exposes aria-controls to the panel while open.

props.name: High contrast
props.description: Under forced-colors, selected and active rows use the system Highlight and HighlightText colors.

groups.title: Tokens
groups.description: Theme defaults live on :root. Override these globally or on a local host.

props.name: --df-option-list-width
props.description: Fixed root width when width is a CSS length. Set by the width prop.

props.name: --df-input-bg
props.description: Built-in search field fill. Override with searchBackground or OptionListSearch background.

props.name: --df-option-list-surface-bg
props.description: Panel surface fill. Defaults follow chrome (popover or card). Set via background.

props.name: --df-option-list-surface-fg
props.description: Panel text color. Set via foreground.

props.name: --df-option-list-surface-border-color
props.description: Outer surface stroke. Set via borderColor.

props.name: --df-option-list-surface-border-width
props.description: Outer surface stroke width. Set via borderWidth.

props.name: --df-option-list-surface-border-style
props.description: Outer surface stroke style. Set via borderStyle.

props.name: --df-option-list-divider-color
props.description: Header, search, and footer hairline rules. Set via dividerColor.

props.name: --df-option-list-surface-radius
props.description: Surface corner radius. Set via radius.

props.name: --df-option-list-min-width
props.description: Minimum open-list width. Defaults to var(--df-menu-min-width).

props.name: --df-option-list-group-padding
props.description: Padding on OptionListGroup. Used by inset separators.

props.name: --df-option-list-separator-inset
props.description: Horizontal inset when OptionListSeparator inset is true.

props.name: --df-option-list-scroll-thumb-gap
props.description: Space on each side of the scrollbar thumb. Overridable via scrollThumbGap.

props.name: --df-option-list-scroll-track-width
props.description: Track width used to reserve the option list scroll gutter.

props.name: --df-menu-min-width
props.description: Minimum menu width.

props.name: --df-menu-max-height
props.description: Maximum panel height before scrolling.

props.name: --df-menu-stacked-max-height
props.description: Maximum body height when header, search, or footer stacks the panel.

props.name: --df-submenu-min-width
props.description: Minimum nested submenu width.

props.name: --df-submenu-max-height
props.description: Maximum nested submenu height.

props.name: --popover
props.description: Panel fill.

props.name: --popover-foreground
props.description: Panel text color.

props.name: --foreground
props.description: Option label color.

props.name: --muted-foreground
props.description: Secondary label and muted chrome.

props.name: --accent
props.description: Hover and highlight row fill.

props.name: --accent-foreground
props.description: Hover and highlight row text.

props.name: --primary
props.description: Checked checkbox fill and border.

props.name: --primary-foreground
props.description: Checked checkbox glyph color.

props.name: --input
props.description: Checkbox border.

props.name: --background
props.description: Checkbox unchecked fill.
